svg.text: Hexenring on a 360-px phone (360 × 740, to scale)
The rail ("Ringleiste") sits under the field and above the quick strip; it stays visible when a panel opens. The field itself never gets a looper gesture.
empty rail, one hint, the beat line says "frei"
